title: Expenses
subtitle: Everything that leaves the business: expenses, withdrawals and cash in.
empty: There are no expenses with these filters.

form.title: Record expense
form.source: Where did the money come from?
form.sourceCashHint: Paid from the drawer: it is subtracted from the cash expected at closing.
form.sourceOtherHint: Not paid from the drawer: it is recorded but does not change the closing.
form.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
form.invalidDate: The date cannot be in the future.

void.title: Void expense
void.body: The {{amount}} expense stops counting in the reports and in the cash closing. If it was a mistake, record the right one afterwards.
void.linked: This expense came from a supplier payment: to void it, void the payment from Purchases.

movements.hint: Money that goes in or out of the drawer without being a sale or an expense (for example, adding change or depositing at the bank).
movements.empty: There are no cash movements in this period.
movements.voidBody: The {{amount}} movement stops counting in the cash closing.

categories.hint: Factory categories can be renamed and hidden. Hiding does not delete the expenses already recorded.
categories.name: Name
